name: pdf2md
description: Convert PDF attachments into Markdown through an authenticated MCP server, with an optional local Python CLI.

author.name: THE DUCKS IN A ROW S.L.

interface.longDescription: Convert PDF files attached to a ChatGPT chat into downloadable Markdown files using Microsoft MarkItDown. PDF2MD receives the attachment through an authenticated MCP endpoint, processes it temporarily, deletes the source after conversion, and does not retain the PDF or generated Markdown. For local, on-device conversion, the repository also provides a Python command-line tool.
interface.developerName: THE DUCKS IN A ROW S.L.
defaultPrompt: Convert the attached PDF to Markdown.
Convert all attached PDFs to Markdown.

publication.release_notes: Adds an authenticated MCP server with Google, Microsoft and Apple OAuth/OIDC, a 100 MB daily quota per account, and temporary PDF processing.
